Hello,

I saw your opening for a Graphic Designer at Unicorn Events and wanted to apply, as I have been following how your team builds integrated marketing campaigns.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives, including event marketing assets, presentations, and print-ready collateral managed for color accuracy and sizing.

My social campaign for a fashion brand demonstrated strong marketing creative execution by driving a 15% increase in follower engagement, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Since this role is based in Nagpur where I am currently living, I can start right away. Would you be open to a quick look at my campaign work this week?

Ananya

My case study Bounceless demonstrates structured UX thinking and a clean verification experience for B2B users, which you can review in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai for this onsite role, and I would welcome a quick fifteen-minute call to share my design process.
